IIT Kharagpur Extends JAM 2027 Registration Deadline

Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kharagpur has extended the registration deadline for the Joint Admission Test (JAM) 2027. The exam is scheduled to be held on February 14. One report states the registration deadline was extended to October 19.
